## Low Pay Dampens Korean Worker Deployments to Samsung's Texas Fab Ahead of Ramp

Staffing friction at Samsung's Taylor fab introduces execution risk into its US advanced-node ramp; a meaningful delay would indirectly reinforce TSMC's competitive positioning in US-based leading-edge capacity and sustain customer concentration there near term.

- Below-expectation compensation is slowing Korean worker dispatch to Samsung's Taylor, TX facility.
- Headline explicitly frames the issue as occurring 'before ramp-up,' signaling potential schedule risk to the US foundry timeline.
- No quantification of staffing shortfall magnitude or timeline impact in the coverage.
- Competitive-capacity signal: a delayed Samsung US ramp could benefit rival fabs on relative timing.
